subject: Renewal: staged commit migration and per-token ceiling clarifications
messages:
From: Emma Tan <emma@brightline.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lucas O'Neil <lucas@brightline.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — usage tiers and caps question

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you're well. We're kicking off our renewal planning for July and have a couple of asks that will determine our commit sizing:

- We expect 2x token growth YoY but with big quarter-to-quarter variability (spikey ML pipelines).
- We need a per-token ceiling for peak months (we can't tolerate surprise per-token spikes beyond an agreed ceiling).
- Any right-sizing options if we under/overcommit in the first 6 months — e.g., true-up windows or phased migration between tiers.

Attached is a simple usage projection and current credit balance (Brightline_Renewal_Ask_2027.xlsx).

Can we get a proposed structure that includes a per-token ceiling, staged commit migration (so we can ramp), and a clear uplift cap year-over-year? Also please include any options for smoothing (monthly smoothing, quarterly true-ups).

Thanks — Emma
Emma Tan
Director of Engineering, Brightline Labs

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Tan <emma@brightline.ai>
Cc: Lucas O'Neil <lucas@brightline.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — usage tiers and caps question

Hi Emma — thanks for the context and the workbook. Attached note from our side coming shortly; looping in Aditya (sales lead) to surface the commercial options.

Quick answers up front:
- We can offer an explicit per-token ceiling for peak months as part of a staged commit, with a defined overage band and an associated capped overage rate.
- We typically support a two-stage commit migration: (A) a conservative baseline commit for first 6 months + (B) an optional staged upsell window (months 7–12) with predefined uplift caps.
- For smoothing: monthly smoothing + a single mid-year true-up is workable for customers with spikey traffic.

I'll coordinate a short proposal and get you a PDF with the model and example numbers tomorrow.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Brightline renewal — suggested structure

Team — draft thoughts before I send the official proposal to Emma/Lucas:

1) Staggered commit migration (recommended):
   - Year 1 baseline commit: 60% of projected annual usage (reduces initial commit risk for customer).
   - Stage window (months 7–12): option to move to 85% of projected annual usage, with pre-agreed uplift tiers.

2) Per-token ceilings and overage bands:
   - Define a hard per-token ceiling for any given month = baseline per-token price + capped overage rate (example: +20% over baseline if ceiling exceeded).
   - Overage billing capped at monthly cap (e.g., no more than 1.5x baseline monthly invoice for overages).

3) Renewal uplift cap and smoothing:
   - Uplift limit year-over-year: recommend 15% (hard cap) with an exception path for validated product launches.
   - Monthly smoothing: allow rolling 30-day smoothing to avoid short-term spikes.

4) True-up and right-sizing:
   - One mid-year true-up (end of month 6) to reconcile usage vs commit and shift to new baseline for billing months 7–12.

Open questions for Rishi/Legal: do we want to offer a linked credit mechanism (unused commit converted to credits usable for 12 months) vs cash refund? Credits preferred for retention.

If this looks good I'll package as Renewal Proposal v2 and include sample numbers from their workbook.

-Aditya

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Tan <emma@brightline.ai>, Lucas O'Neil <lucas@brightline.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal proposal (v2) — staged migration + per-token ceiling (attached)

Hi Emma / Lucas — thanks for the patience. Attached is our Renewal Proposal v2 (renewal-proposal-Brightline-v2.pdf) that implements the staggered-commit approach we discussed. Summary of key points below:

- Baseline (months 1–6): 60% committed annual tokens at $0.0009 / token (hosted API baseline).
- Stage window (months 7–12): option to transition to 85% commit with stepwise discounts: +10% commit -> additional 3% discount, +25% commit -> additional 6% discount (example schedule in Appendix).
- Per-month ceiling: if a month exceeds committed tokens, overage charged at baseline * 1.20 up to a hard monthly overage cap of 1.5x baseline invoice. Any overage beyond the cap triggers we will engage via a short-form review rather than automatic billing.
- Uplift cap: 15% YoY uplift cap on list per-token rates. Exceptional product launches can be submitted for special approval with usage proof.
- Smoothing / true-up: rolling 30-day smoothing applied to per-day token figures; single mid-year true-up at month 6 to right-size the second half commit.
- Credits: unused portion of baseline commit converts to platform credits valid 12 months (preferred; cash refund option available for enterprise legal).

Action items for Brightline:
1) Review the attached PDF and confirm the stage-window percent you'd like (we used your projections to default to 85%).
2) If you accept, sign the DocuSign (link below) and we'll seed the new commit the day the agreement is executed.
